shelters.name: Greater Birmingham Humane Society
shelters.description: The oldest and largest animal shelter in Alabama, founded in 1883. GBHS promotes humane treatment of animals through education, advocacy, and services, and manages Animal Care & Control for Jefferson County.

shelters.name: Greater Huntsville Humane Society
shelters.description: A 501(c)(3) no-kill animal shelter rescuing North Alabama's homeless animals for over 55 years. Offers community programs including pet food bank and wellness clinic.

shelters.name: Montgomery Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1920, Montgomery Humane Society is an open admission shelter preventing cruelty to animals through shelter operations, adoption services, and investigating abuse cases.

shelters.name: Mobile SPCA
shelters.description: Founded in 1885, one of Alabama's oldest continuously operating charitable organizations. A no-kill, limited intake shelter offering adoption guarantees for healthy or treatable animals.

shelters.name: Humane Society of West Alabama
shelters.description: Since 1971, a no-kill, volunteer-run, cage-free nonprofit adoption center. Operates entirely on donor support with no government funding.

shelters.name: Morgan County Humane Society
shelters.description: Established in 2004 as the first no-kill organization in North Alabama. Their facility sits on over eight acres in rural Morgan County.

shelters.name: Baldwin Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1979, Baldwin County AL Humane Society has been a driving force in animal welfare serving the entire Baldwin County area.

shelters.name: Lee County Humane Society
shelters.description: Developed in 1974, a 501(c)3 non-profit, open-admission shelter serving Auburn and Opelika. Provides adoption services, educational programs, and community awareness.

shelters.name: East Alabama Humane Society
shelters.description: The only no-kill shelter facility within Russell County, Alabama. Mission is to promote and enable saving the lives of as many unwanted pets as possible.

shelters.name: Shelby Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded in 1977 to care for unwanted cats and dogs in Shelby County. Operates the county animal shelter through contract with Shelby County.

shelters.name: Calhoun County Humane Society
shelters.description: Established in 1973, a 501(c)3 non-profit shelter for homeless pets. Known as The Animal Shelter, serving Jacksonville, AL and surrounding areas.

shelters.name: Prattville/Autauga Humane Society
shelters.description: A non-profit 501(c)3 animal shelter and adoption center serving the Prattville/Autauga area, providing homeless animals with shelter and care.

shelters.name: Humane Society Pet Rescue and Adoption Center
shelters.description: Saves hundreds of homeless pets in the Gadsden and Attalla areas by providing temporary shelter, food, veterinary care, and educational outreach programs.

shelters.name: Wiregrass Pet Rescue and Adoption Center
shelters.description: A 501(c)3 nonprofit dedicated to creating an exemplary animal shelter and community-friendly facility in Dothan/Houston County.

shelters.name: Rocket City Rescue
shelters.description: A volunteer-driven rescue committed to helping homeless animals find their forever homes. Offers adoption and foster programs for cats and dogs.

shelters.name: Florence Lauderdale Animal Services
shelters.description: Receives all stray, abandoned, and surrendered pets in Florence and Lauderdale County. Works with fosters, volunteers, and rescues to rehome thousands of homeless animals yearly.

shelters.name: Shoals PAWS
shelters.description: All-volunteer group serving Lauderdale, Colbert, and Franklin Counties since 2003. Dedicated to spay/neuter initiatives, TNR, and rescuing animals in need through foster homes.

shelters.name: CAAWA - Cullman Area Animal Welfare Association
shelters.description: A 501(c)3 non-profit, all-volunteer, no-kill organization rescuing dogs and cats in Cullman County to decrease shelter surrenders.

shelters.name: Decatur Animal Services
shelters.description: City of Decatur municipal animal services providing animal control, shelter, and adoption services for the Decatur community.

shelters.name: Alabama SPCA
shelters.description: A statewide SPCA organization dedicated to animal welfare across Alabama through rescue, adoption, and advocacy programs.

shelters.name: Two By Two Rescue League
shelters.description: Rescues and re-homes lost, abandoned, and neglected animals while educating the public on responsible pet ownership.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Elmore County
shelters.description: Rescues animals, prevents cruelty, promotes responsible pet ownership, and finds loving homes through education and community engagement.

shelters.name: 4Legs4Justice Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Partners with Greater Birmingham Humane Society, operating at a facility in McClellan, Anniston to rescue and rehome animals.

shelters.name: SAVE-A-PET at the Dothan Animal Shelter
shelters.description: A partnership between the City of Dothan's Animal Shelter and SAVE A PET non-profit rescue, working to minimize euthanasia of adoptable pets.

shelters.name: Steel City Cat Rescue
shelters.description: A cat-focused rescue organization in the Birmingham area dedicated to rescuing and rehoming homeless cats.

shelters.name: Rescue Rangers
shelters.description: A rescue organization in the Decatur area focused on saving and rehoming dogs in North Alabama.

shelters.name: Huntsville Animal Services
shelters.description: City of Huntsville municipal animal services providing animal control and shelter services for the Huntsville community.

shelters.name: Baldwin County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Baldwin County government-operated animal shelter providing animal control and adoption services for Baldwin County residents.

shelters.name: Shoals Animal Advocates
shelters.description: A 501(c)3 non-profit foster-based rescue promoting the rescuing, fostering and adoption of homeless dogs and cats in Colbert, Lauderdale, and Franklin counties.

shelters.name: For Paws Rescue
shelters.description: An animal welfare organization in Auburn founded in 2004, dedicated to rescuing and rehoming animals in the Lee County area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Alabama animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Includes major metro areas (Birmingham, Huntsville, Montgomery, Mobile, Tuscaloosa) and regional organizations across the state. Greater Birmingham Humane Society is the oldest (1883) and largest shelter in Alabama.
